_comment: Manual releases — for records that exist on Bandcamp or elsewhere but NOT on Spotify (yet). These get merged into the Spotify-fetched discography in src/lib/spotify.ts. Shape matches NormalizedRelease minus the platformLinks (which we leave null since Odesli only resolves Spotify URLs). Reflections was removed 2026-07-31 when the real Spotify release went live (album id 0W0m7wwHe5SqugrvuMZJtU).
